Subject: Thanks for joining Redwood at DataCraft — quick intro & demo?

Hi Aisha / Arjun,

Great to meet you briefly at the DataCraft expo earlier today — appreciate you stopping by the Redwood booth. We had a few conversations about reducing inference cost for real-time recommendation scoring; I wanted to follow up with a short intro and offer a 30-minute demo tailored to Polaris's use case.

If you already set up a trial through our self-serve sign-up, thanks — I pulled your account and can show a quick plan that maps to the workload you mentioned (sparse sessions, 128-token median, occasional long-tail spikes).

Two quick options:
- Book a 30-min slot on my calendar: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min-demo?month=aug-2026
- Or tell me 2 time windows that work for you this week and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Proposed times (PDT):
- Fri 8/28 3:00–3:30pm
- Mon 8/31 10:00–10:30am

I’m attaching a 2-slide intro deck and a sample demo agenda so you can preview what we’ll cover. If you want Ben (our AE) on the call to speak to pricing and contract fit, I’ve cc’d him.

Attachments: [Polaris_IntroDeck.pdf (PDF - 2MB)], [demo-agenda-template.docx (DOCX - 45KB)]

Thanks — Kim
